title: Show PDF attachments in the chat pane as a tile that opens in the built-in viewer
notes: A user message mentioning a PDF (@path.pdf, relative to the session folder), or a Read call on a .pdf, shows a small [PDF File] tile like an image thumbnail. Click, or the image key, opens the PDF full size in an overlay with Chromium's built-in PDF viewer (window needs plugins: true). Claude's behavior unchanged: the @mention is still sent as is. Main reads the file only if it exists, ends in .pdf and is under a size cap; a missing file shows the tile with 'not found'. No in-chat page preview.

comments.body: Shipped in PR #99: [PDF File] tile for @mentioned and Read PDFs, pdf:read in main (.pdf, file, at most 5 MB), viewer overlay with plugins on, version 2.5.0. Needs a hand check that the viewer renders the blob URL.
Review loop: 2 rounds, 8 threads fixed in a59e6c7 and 3d338bc (Escape and focus stay with the viewer, PDF links go to the browser, frame navigation decided in links.ts with tests). Merged as PR #99.
